meta.description: Curated catalog of modern bootable ISO images for system rescue, repair, diagnostics and recovery.

core.description: Essential rescue tools — fits on a 8 GB USB drive (~4 GB total)

standard.description: Well-rounded toolkit — fits on a 16 GB USB drive (~10 GB total)

full.description: Maximum coverage — recommended 64 GB USB drive (~35 GB total)

hirens-pe.name: Hiren's BootCD PE
hirens-pe.description: The official modern successor to Hiren's BootCD. Windows 11 PE environment with 100+ repair and diagnostic tools including antivirus, disk management, password recovery, and network utilities.
hirens-pe.notes: Requires x64 CPU. Based on Windows 11 PE. Includes MiniTool Partition Wizard, AOMEI Backupper, Malwarebytes, CrystalDiskInfo, Autoruns, and many more.

sergei-strelec.name: Sergei Strelec WinPE
sergei-strelec.description: Highly popular all-in-one Windows PE rescue toolkit for password resets, driver fixes, BSOD diagnosis, disk repair, and deep system repair. Updated frequently.
sergei-strelec.notes: Very large (~3.8 GB). Includes an enormous suite of Windows tools. Russian origin but fully functional in English.

winpe-dartpe.name: Microsoft DaRT PE (via Windows ADK)
winpe-dartpe.description: Microsoft Diagnostics and Recovery Toolset — includes Windows Defender Offline, Crash Analyzer, File Restore, and registry editor for offline Windows systems.
winpe-dartpe.notes: Requires Microsoft license. Freely available as part of MDOP. Must be built using the ADK DaRT add-on.

systemrescue.name: SystemRescue
systemrescue.description: The gold standard Linux rescue system. Includes GParted, filesystem tools (fsck, e2fsck, ntfsfix), TestDisk, PhotoRec, network diagnostic tools, SSH, and a full Xfce desktop. Supports most modern hardware.
systemrescue.notes: Excellent for: partition repair, data recovery (TestDisk/PhotoRec), filesystem repair, network diagnostics.

rescuezilla.name: Rescuezilla
rescuezilla.description: User-friendly GUI-based disk imaging and cloning tool. The easiest way to create full-disk backups and restore them. Compatible with Clonezilla images. Based on Ubuntu.
rescuezilla.notes: Best choice for disk imaging for non-technical users. Reads/writes Clonezilla, Foxclone, and other formats.

clonezilla.name: Clonezilla Live
clonezilla.description: Professional-grade partition and disk cloning tool. Supports all major filesystems including ext4, NTFS, FAT32, btrfs, and more. Can clone to/from network (NFS, Samba) or local drives.
clonezilla.notes: More powerful than Rescuezilla but less user-friendly. Ideal for imaging many machines over a network.

gparted-live.name: GParted Live
gparted-live.description: Standalone bootable version of GParted — the most powerful free partition editor. Create, resize, move, delete, and format partitions on any disk. Supports all modern partition types.
gparted-live.notes: The definitive free alternative to Partition Magic. Supports ext2/3/4, NTFS, FAT, btrfs, xfs, f2fs and more.

ubuntu-live.name: Ubuntu Live
ubuntu-live.description: The most widely-used Linux live environment. Excellent hardware compatibility including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and most peripherals. Useful for testing hardware, accessing files from a broken OS, and general recovery tasks.
ubuntu-live.notes: Large download but includes a full desktop environment with Firefox, LibreOffice, and file manager.

fedora-live.name: Fedora Workstation Live
fedora-live.description: Fedora's live environment with excellent modern hardware support, useful as a rescue environment and for accessing NTFS/ext4 filesystems from a broken OS.
fedora-live.notes: Good option for modern hardware. GNOME desktop. Includes Fedora's excellent hardware detection.

debian-live.name: Debian Live (XFCE)
debian-live.description: Stable and minimal live environment based on Debian. Extremely reliable and low on resources. Good fallback for older hardware.
debian-live.notes: Very stable. Xfce desktop is lightweight. Good for older or low-RAM machines.

memtest86plus.name: MemTest86+
memtest86plus.description: The open-source standard for RAM testing. Tests all memory cells for errors using multiple test algorithms. Essential first step when diagnosing system instability or crashes.
memtest86plus.notes: Tiny ISO, boots instantly. Run for at least 2 full passes. Errors = bad RAM.

memtest86-uefi.name: MemTest86 (UEFI edition by PassMark)
memtest86-uefi.description: Commercial-grade RAM tester with UEFI Secure Boot support, graphical interface, and detailed reports. Free version available with full test suite.
memtest86-uefi.notes: Better graphics and reporting than MemTest86+. Preferred for modern UEFI systems.

hdat2.name: HDAT2 (Hard Disk Diagnostic)
hdat2.description: Freeware HDD diagnostic tool that tests and repairs (regenerates) bad sectors on hard drives. Supports ATA, SATA, SSD, USB and more. The modern successor to the classic HDAT2 from HBCD 15.2.
hdat2.notes: Legacy BIOS only. Best for low-level HDD diagnosis and bad sector recovery.

tails.name: Tails OS
tails.description: Privacy-focused live OS that routes all internet traffic through Tor. Leaves no trace on the host computer. Ideal for secure communications, anonymous browsing, and privacy-sensitive tasks.
tails.notes: Must be verified with the official Tails verification tool before use.

kali-live.name: Kali Linux Live
kali-live.description: Industry-standard penetration testing and digital forensics platform. Includes 600+ security tools. Useful for network analysis, wireless security testing, and security auditing.
kali-live.notes: Large download. Includes Wireshark, Metasploit, Aircrack-ng, Nmap, and many more. Use ethically.

caine.name: CAINE (Computer Aided INvestigative Environment)
caine.description: Digital forensics live distribution. Non-destructive by design — automatically mounts drives in read-only mode. Includes Autopsy, Sleuth Kit, Wireshark, and other forensic tools.
caine.notes: Best choice for evidence collection. All drives mounted read-only by default to preserve evidence integrity.

deft-zero.name: DEFT Zero
deft-zero.description: Digital Evidence and Forensics Toolkit. Lightweight forensics environment based on Lubuntu. Includes hundreds of open-source forensics tools.
deft-zero.notes: More lightweight than CAINE. Good for field forensics work.

parted-magic.name: Parted Magic
parted-magic.description: Professional disk partitioning and data recovery environment. Includes GParted, TestDisk, PhotoRec, Clonezilla, dd, ddrescue, and extensive filesystem tools. The paid successor to the free version included in HBCD 15.2.
parted-magic.notes: Now a paid product (~$15). Worth purchasing for professional use. Free versions are outdated and unsupported.

knoppix.name: KNOPPIX
knoppix.description: One of the oldest and most respected Linux live CDs. Excellent hardware auto-detection, supports a huge range of legacy hardware while also running on modern systems. Includes comprehensive recovery tools.
knoppix.notes: Large ISO but includes a massive software collection. KDE desktop. Excellent for older hardware.

netboot-xyz.name: netboot.xyz
netboot-xyz.description: Network boot launcher that can boot dozens of OS installers and rescue tools directly from the internet. Requires network access. Essentially a portal to everything else — useful when USB space is limited.
netboot-xyz.notes: Tiny ISO (~2 MB). Requires active internet connection. Can boot Ubuntu, Fedora, Kali, Windows PE, and many more on-demand.

ipxe.name: iPXE Boot ISO
ipxe.description: Open-source network boot firmware. Allows booting from HTTP, iSCSI, AoE, Infiniband and more. Advanced option for IT professionals and network boot setups.
ipxe.notes: Tiny ISO. Chainloads from your existing DHCP/PXE infrastructure or can be used standalone with a URL.
